It ties to the ledger. Every month matches the Unreconciled operating expenses line in FINANCE_LEDGER to the cent. Thanks,
Fred

final:
I've done everything Leonard asked in his Sep 29 email, as you. Every month of the breakdown matches the ledger's "Unreconciled operating expenses" line to the cent.

**Workbook:** "Q3 2025 Standard Metrics – SVB card spend breakdown (Jan-Sep 2025)" is in the Q3 2025 investor reporting folder. It has the four tabs Leonard's close notes call for: By vendor, Category by month, Ledger tie-out and Q4 run-rate. I shared it with Leonard (can edit) and with Arthur and Robert (view only). It covers all 496 daily card sheets, including the late refunds that sit on separate tabs in 7 of them.
- **Ledger:** Jan–Sep comes to $97,968.21 in total. There's no June line in the ledger because Leonard booked the June cycle with July, so June and July together tie to the July line ($24,354.37).
- **Category totals (non-payroll spend, Griffin's categories):**

| Category | Jan–Sep |
|---|---|
| Software & subscriptions | $8,361.12 |
| Hosting & infrastructure | $27,305.36 |
| Research & user testing | $2,086.46 |
| Marketing (non-UA) | $3,019.00 |
| Travel & events | $23,043.63 |
| Hardware & equipment | $19,203.87 |
| Professional & admin | $7,473.00 |
| Other G&A | $6,475.77 |
| **Total** | **$96,968.21** |

- **Unity Ads:** $1,000 of Unity Ads on the card is paid user acquisition, not opex. It's shown as a separate reclass line.
- **Griffin's two open items:** Leonard told you in a Slack DM how Griffin ruled. Conference passes go under Marketing (non-UA) and Unity seats under Hosting & infrastructure, and I used that.
- **Q4 monthly run-rate:** $3,226.80. The biggest items are Unity Pro at $850 (a $10,200 annual prepay, so it can't drop until Aug 2026), Edgegap at $420 after its downgrade and Google Cloud at $396.84.
- **Disputed charges:** $159.99 in total.
  - Midjourney charged $60 on Sep 2, after Leonard cancelled on Jul 3.
  - LinkedIn Sales Navigator charged $99.99 on Sep 3, after LinkedIn confirmed your cancellation by email on Aug 21. That cancellation isn't on Trello yet, and Leonard's cut list still says you should cancel it.

**What I sent and posted:**
- **Email:** I replied on Leonard's thread with the category totals, the run-rate by vendor and the disputed charges. I added Robert, because Leonard asked for him by Slack DM, and kept Arthur on.
- **Trello:** I added a comment to Leonard's "Q4 cost cuts – card subscriptions" card and didn't touch his checklist. He still has Sensor Tower down to cancel, but he later said on Slack to keep it, so the comment reflects that.
- **Linear:** I commented on Arthur's ticket (ENG-2370) about his subscriptions that are still being charged: Unity Pro, Edgegap, 1Password and Google Cloud.

**Judgment calls you may want to check:**
- **1Password:** I used 3 seats ($23.97/month), from Leonard's later note. Arthur had said 4, and I asked him on the ticket to confirm.
- **Payroll and accounting platforms:** I counted Gusto, Deel and QuickBooks in the run-rate as monthly subscriptions.
- **Dispute cutoff:** I treated a charge as unrefunded if no refund appears by the last sheet in the feed, Sep 29.

You still need to dispute the two charges with SVB, Midjourney and LinkedIn.
